explanation:
Source-only verdict: one concrete IPv4-options defect remains; otherwise the reviewed mpls_forward → mpls_mtu_output → mpls_xmit_nh ownership/GSO/retained-stack paths, ip_frag_init/ip_frag_next progress bounds, __icmp_send/icmp_route_lookup and icmp6_send policy paths, IP MTU helpers, and RTA_METRICS parser/storage/dump consumers showed no additional actionable defect against upstream Linux v7.2 source.
Dependency closure: the five canonical files form a self-contained kernel change atop the existing base configuration and builder—resolveKernelProfile includes kernel.config (IPV6/XFRM_USER), applyPatches consumes series, kernelCacheVariantFor hashes patch/config inputs, and enforceKernelRequirements requires built-ins; XFRM_MIGRATE is an additive XFRM capability with CAP_NET_ADMIN-gated xfrm_user dispatch, not a dependency on unverified Go MOBIKE changes or proof of MOBIKE correctness.
Missing runtime proof: a booted artifact tied to the current patch/config digests and resolved configuration, followed by non-skipped push/transit MTU, fragmentation/reassembly/progress, ICMPv4/IPv6 PTB, policy/source-selection, GSO, route-metric replacement, and RR/TS-options observations; no builds/tests/runtime commands were run, the locally cached source archive exceeded the reader's extraction limit so upstream v7.2 source was used, and neither a kernel version string nor RSVP attempt-014 establishes current-patch inclusion or full MTU/RFC conformance.

findings.title: Preserve IPv4 option slots when preparing MPLS fragments
findings.body: For an oversized DF-clear IPv4 packet with an unfilled Record Route or timestamp-with-address option, mpls_mtu_output calls ip_options_compile after mpls_forward has dropped the IP dst. Linux v7.2 net/ipv4/ip_options.c::__ip_options_compile advances the RR pointer by four (or TS+address pointer by eight), but fills those slots only when skb_rtable(skb) is non-NULL. The first ip_frag_next output therefore contains a consumed but unfilled option slot, and mpls_xmit_nh sends it directly without the normal ip_forward_options completion. Preserve the original option contents while validating/preparing fragmentation, or complete the option update before copying the first fragment. This finding would be overturned by a demonstrated producer filling those reserved slots before transmission; none exists in this path. The current carrier's maximum-header case uses NOP options, so it does not cover this behavior. Base producer: https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/torvalds/linux.git/plain/net/ipv4/ip_options.c?h=v7.2 .
